subject: Sunrise Retail: controlled scaling bake-off & renewal terms
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@sunriseretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@sunriseretail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — request for bake-off and capacity commitments

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from Sunrise: we're approaching our annual contract review and evaluating a replacement for serving. Two vendors (AltScale and NovaServe) ran an internal spike last month and showed better published per-token costs at high QPS, which has raised internal interest in a bake-off.

Our primary asks for the bake-off:
- Sustained 3x baseline traffic for 6 hours (holiday peak simulation)
- Throughput and p95 latency targets (p95 < 300ms at 8k RPS)
- Cost estimate for committed reserved capacity vs on-demand
- Confirmation of data residency and SOC 2 evidence for procurement

We'd like to keep Redwood in the process — can you share a short plan and whether you can guarantee the scaling window? Procurement may push aggressive ramp timing.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Sr. Engineering Manager, Sunrise Retail
[attachment: Sunrise_Bakeoff_Requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@sunriseretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — request for bake-off and capacity commitments

Claire — really appreciate the heads up and the detailed asks. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can run a controlled 6-hour 3x traffic window in a dedicated pool (Dedicated or Private deployments).
- We can provide the SOC2 package and data residency confirmation today for procurement.
- We'll produce a cost delta between reserved capacity (12-month commit) and on-demand for your expected peak.

Proposed next steps:
1) Short tech sync with Marcus and your infra leads this week (30 min).
2) We run a non-production bake-off in our dedicated test plane next Tue that mirrors the request.
3) Joint evaluation report (throughput/latency/cost) + MAP (mutual action plan) for renewal/expansion.

I'm copying Marissa (AM) and Marcus (SE) to slot the tech call and prepare preliminary numbers. Can you confirm who from your infra team will join?

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | naomi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
[attachment: Sunrise_bakeoff_template.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@sunriseretail.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion — request for bake-off and capacity commitments

Claire / Naomi —

I've attached our internal benchmark dump for the topology we'll use: redwood_benchmark_sunrise_20280109.csv and a short appendix with tuning notes. Highlights:
- Baseline (current traffic): 2k RPS, median latency ~95ms.
- Simulated 3x sustained traffic (6h): p95 at steady-state ~240-280ms depending on request payload size; with KV-prefix caching we consistently hold p95 < 300ms for the model variants we recommend.
- Peak token throughput: ~18M tokens/min on a 4-GPU dedicated pool with batch optimizations.

Operational controls we propose for the bake-off:
- Dedicated GPU pool (isolated) with autoscale headroom + manual uplift on scheduled window.
- Pre-warm KV cache using a replay of a representative 2-hour window before test window.
- Transparent fallback policy: if p95 breaches 350ms, we switch to a smaller model variant with identical API schema (no code changes).

Cost guidance (ballpark):
- Reserved 12-month pool (baseline commit matching QPS): estimated 24% lower unit cost vs on-demand for your 12-month profile.
- Short-term burst reserved (3-month) reduces near-term cost but at smaller savings (10-12%).

I'll be ready to run a dry run in our staging cluster on Tue morning. If you want, we can also include a side-by-side AltScale-style replay (they shared a test harness) to normalize measurements.

Attachments: redwood_benchmark_sunrise_20280109.csv (csv, 1.4MB); bakeoff_notes_appendix.txt (txt, 12KB)

—Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@sunriseretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire@sunriseretail.com>, procurement@sunriseretail.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — request for bake-off and capacity commitments

Thanks Naomi / Marcus — procurement here. Two items for legal/compliance:
1) Please share SOC 2 Type II report and any EU data residency SLA language you have (we host EU proof-of-service for a subset of data).
2) Procurement will need a 60-day ramp plan from signature to full production; please indicate blackout dates and escalation contacts.

Also flag: our infra team needs a list of expected IP ranges and a contact for network peering setup.

Rajiv Patel
Head of Procurement, Sunrise Retail
procurement@sunriseretail.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@sunriseretail.com>, Claire Huang <claire@sunriseretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed MAP and short-term concession for Sunrise bake-off 

Rajiv / Claire — attached is a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Sunrise_Redwood_v1.docx). Key commitments:
- Bake-off window: Wed 17 Jan (non-prod) with a 6-hour 3x sustained test.
- Deliverables: joint report (throughput, p50/p95, error rates), cost delta modeling, SOC2 package, network peering checklist.
- Ramp: standard 60-day ramp post-signature; limited blackout the week of Memorial Day due to infra refresh.
- Commercial concession: if Sunrise signs a 12-month reserved capacity commitment within 14 days of report delivery, Redwood will apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to 8% of the first-quarter committed spend.

We believe this balances procurement needs with pace. Please confirm the test window and who from infra/ legal will join. If we get a green light, Marissa will drive scheduling and Aditya will formalize the short-term concession in a term sheet.

Best,
Naomi
[attachment: MAP_Sunrise_Redwood_v1.docx (docx, 42KB)]

Subject: Re: Proposed MAP and short-term concession for Sunrise bake-off 

Thanks — green light from my side.
- Bake-off window confirmed: Wed 17 Jan, please schedule a 30-min prep call with our infra (Ben Wong) and legal (Sofia Mendes) on Fri 13 Jan.
- Procurement will review the MAP and expect the SOC2 package before the prep call.

We're bringing AltScale back into the bake-off for a side-by-side replay as you suggested. Looking forward to the report and the short-term pricing concession.

Claire Huang
Sr. Engineering Manager, Sunrise Retail
